name: linuxdo2obsidian
description: Browser userscripts: linux.do reading and saving, plus GitHub UI translation.

scripts.check: node --check "userscripts/save-obsidian/linux.do 帖子保存到 Obsidian.user.js" && node --check "userscripts/topic-reader/linux.do 帖子弹框阅读.user.js" && node --check "userscripts/github-chinese/GitHub 中文化.user.js"
scripts.format: npx --yes prettier --write "userscripts/*/*.user.js" "tests/*.js" "tools/*.js" README.md "docs/*.md" userscripts/README.md versions/README.md package.json
